protocol.workloads: Original hello, primes, json, object-stable/churn; addition: 20,000 function calls; primes-var changes only let to var, no escaping closures.
protocol.timings: Serial runs; 3 fresh processes per target, 2 warmup + 5 measured batches/process, adaptive 1–500 calls/batch; median of process medians.
protocol.startup: hello: 3 warmup + 15 spawn-to-exit samples/process, hrtime; includes stdout and shutdown.
protocol.clock: Other cases use Date.now, 1 ms batch resolution; each batch divided by calls/batch. Node addition batches only 1–2 ms: do not interpret its exact ratio.
protocol.order: Oseo/native targets measured together, order reversed in round 2. Node measured afterwards in a separate serial pass after correcting its staged input path.
protocol.controls: O2 appends -O2 only to generated application C. No-sanitizers control also changes runtime archive cache key; all standard targets keep upstream flags.
protocol.diagnostics: Separate untimed binaries: backend observeSpecialization=true emits guard counters; C entrypoint additionally prints allocation_attempts before teardown. Counts include startup; allocation attempts include heap/buffer malloc/calloc/realloc and are not object counts.
protocol.profiles: macOS sample, 2 s at 1 ms; launches/stops only its own child. May include startup and sanitizer/runtime overhead; no precise percentage claims.
protocol.validation: Every successful workload output checked. Object benchmark checksum accepts both undefined and zero; separate probe validates alias identity, actual delete, absence and reinsertion order.
protocol.limits: Interactive Apple M1 host, no CPU pinning/thermal control; single upstream revision, macOS arm64 only. Source TS failures are preserved, not rewritten. No p95 or small effect claims from 3 process medians.
